tanks.title: Tanks - Dominate the Battlefield in Epic Tank Battles
tanks.description: Enter the explosive world of Tanks, a fast-paced 2D top-down shooter where only the strongest survive! Take control of powerful tanks, engage in intense battles, and outmaneuver enemies with strategic dodging, shields, and environmental advantages. Blast Your Enemies – Use an arsenal of weapons to destroy enemy tanks before they take you down! Defend & Dodge – Shield yourself and weave through deadly projectiles to stay in the fight. Upgrade & Conquer – Earn coins to enhance your tank, unlock devastating firepower, and become unstoppable. Addictive Gameplay – Fast, intense, and action-packed!
